definitions.explanation: The automated selling of goods through machines, without the need for a human clerk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought water from a vending machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are many vending machines at the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自動販売|じどうはんばい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦トップ→トップ：03862_toppu⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧や⟦{日用品|にちようひん}→日用品：09547_nichiyouhin⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{扱|あつか}っている→扱う：01862_atsukau⟧。
examples.english: Japan's vending machine market is among the top in the world, handling not only beverages but also food and daily necessities.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧ (automatic) and ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (sales). Almost always encountered in the compound ⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧ (vending machine), often abbreviated to ⟦{自販機|じはんき}→自販機：09703_jihanki⟧ in casual speech.

Japan is famous for its extraordinarily high density of vending machines — roughly one for every 23 people. They sell everything from drinks and snacks to hot meals, umbrellas, and even fresh flowers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧: vending machine
- ⟦{自販機|じはんき}→自販機：09703_jihanki⟧: vending machine (abbreviation)
- {自動販売|じどうはんばい}⟦コーナー→コーナー：10865_koonaa⟧: vending machine area
- ⟦{飲料|いんりょう}→飲料：03011_inryou⟧⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧: beverage vending machine

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧: sales; selling
- ⟦{自動|じどう}→自動：03339_jidou⟧: automatic
